paper_title: Space Complexity of Reachability in Simple Path Graphs
classifications: Theory of computation → Problems, reductions and completeness
statement: Open Question. Is the complexity of the reachability problem for simple path graphs, SimplePath-Reach ∈ ReachUL? Such an improvement would give a simultaneous poly(n) time and O(log2 n) space algorithm for this problem, placing it in SC2 and thereby improving [11].
context: 5 Summary and Open Problem The reachability problem restricted to reach unambiguous graphs is complete for the class ReachUL (under many-one logspace reductions) [13]. In this work, we studied the complexity of reachability problems specifically for simple path graphs (a superclass of reach unambiguous graphs) and showed that the problem is in UL ∩ coUL. Since ReachUL ⊆ UL ∩ coUL, as an open question, we ask whether our result can be improved to ReachUL. Open Question. Is the complexity of the reachability problem for simple path graphs, SimplePath-Reach ∈ ReachUL? Such an improvement would give a simultaneous poly(n) time and O(log2 n) space algorithm for this problem, placing it in SC2 and thereby improving [11].
